capital_expenditure.basis: Cash paid for property, plant and equipment (cash-flow-statement magnitude).
capital_expenditure.label: Capital expenditure

cash_and_equivalents.basis: Carrying value of cash and cash equivalents at the fiscal period end.
cash_and_equivalents.label: Cash and cash equivalents

debt_current.basis: Current portion of reported long-term debt at the fiscal period end.
debt_current.label: Interest-bearing debt, current portion

debt_noncurrent.basis: Noncurrent interest-bearing debt at the fiscal period end.
debt_noncurrent.label: Interest-bearing debt, noncurrent

debt_short_term_borrowings.basis: Short-term borrowings outside the long-term debt schedule at the fiscal period end.
debt_short_term_borrowings.label: Short-term borrowings and commercial paper
transformations: Kept separate from the long-term debt split because issuers such as AAPL report it outside LongTermDebt; combined into the short-term total for comparison only.

debt_short_term_total.basis: Comparable basis for a single reported short-term debt figure.
debt_short_term_total.label: Short-term interest-bearing debt (current portion plus short-term borrowings)
transformations: Derived, not reported. Used only to compare with an externally published short-term debt figure.

debt_total_reported.basis: Issuer-reported long-term debt total including its current portion.
debt_total_reported.label: Reported long-term debt total (cross-check only)
transformations: This is not total liabilities and not operating lease obligations; it is used only to reconcile the current/noncurrent split.

diluted_weighted_average_shares.basis: Diluted weighted-average shares outstanding over the annual period.
diluted_weighted_average_shares.label: Diluted weighted-average shares
transformations: An instant common shares outstanding count is a different measure and does not satisfy this field.

interest_bearing_debt_total.basis: Current portion plus noncurrent long-term debt as separately reported.
interest_bearing_debt_total.label: Long-term debt, current plus noncurrent (sum of reported parts)
transformations: Derived, not reported. It excludes short-term borrowings, operating leases and total liabilities.

net_income_common.basis: Income attributable to common shareholders for the annual period.
net_income_common.label: Net income attributable to common shareholders
transformations: When only NetIncomeLoss (consolidated) is available the value is labelled NET_INCOME_TO_COMMON_UNADJUSTED and cannot be treated as common income.

operating_income_ebit.basis: Reported consolidated operating income/loss. EBIT is not derived from net income.

revenue.basis: Consolidated total revenue for the annual period.
revenue.label: Revenue
